basic_details.job_title: District Panchayat DNH Gram Rojgar Sahayak Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Rural Development, District Panchayat, Dadra and Nagar Haveli (Rural Employment Division), under the U.T. Administration Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu, is filling 05 Gram Rojgar Sahayak (GRS) posts purely on short-term contract basis under the Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin). Graduates aged 18-30 years may submit the filled Annexure-A application form with copies of documents to the office of the Programme Officer, VB G RAM G, in Silvassa on or before 11 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: DNH Gram Rojgar Sahayak (GRS) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Department of Rural Development (Rural Employment Division), District Panchayat, Dadra and Nagar Haveli, Silvassa
Graduate from a recognized University or equivalent
Offline – application form submitted to the office in Silvassa

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Office of Programme Officer, VB G RAM G, Department of Rural Development, (Rural Employment Division), District Panchayat, Dadra and Nagar Haveli, Silvassa - 396230 Fill the Annexure-A Application Form [for the post of Gram Rojgar Sahayak (GRS)]: name in block letters, father's name, address for communication, mobile and alternate number, e-mail address, date of birth, age as on 30/11/2026 (years, months, days), category, languages known and marital status. Fill the educational qualification table (Graduation, Post Graduation, any other, Computer Qualification) with stream/special subject, board/university, year of passing and percentage, and give work experience, if any. Sign the declaration, with date and place. Attach attested copies of the relevant certificates and documents. Submit the form to the office of the Programme Officer at the address above on or before 11 December 2026. The notice refers to postal/courier submission and states that the department will not be responsible for postal/courier delays, so an application sent by post or courier should reach the office by the last date. The notice does not mention what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There are 05 vacancies for the single post of Gram Rojgar Sahayak (GRS). The pay is Rs. 18,000/- per month (consolidated) plus Travelling Allowance. The notice gives no category-wise break-up of the vacancies. Educational qualification: Graduate from a recognized University or equivalent. Language: Well versed with local language. Computer skills: Good command over Computer applications and MS Office Suite. Experience: Experience of working with community. Age limit: Between 18-30 years. The application form asks for age as on 30/11/2026. Preference: Preference shall be given to the candidate with working experience in similar scheme/projects in government domain. Nature of appointment: Purely on short term contract basis. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested copy of valid proof of date of birth Attested copy of valid category proof (ST/SC/OBC/Others, as filled in the form) Attested copies of relevant certificates/documents (educational, computer qualification and work experience, as filled in the form) All original certificates, including Educational, Experience and Identity Proof, should be produced for verification during the process.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview: no TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview. Original certificates including Educational, Experience and Identity Proof will be verified during the process. Preference shall be given to candidates with working experience in similar scheme/projects in government domain. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for attending the interview. Applicants will be summarily rejected if found deviant from the prescribed format and required criteria, without assigning any reason. The District Programme Coordinator (VB - G RAM G)/Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat, Dadra and Nagar Haveli reserves the right to terminate the recruitment process at any stage or hold the result without any reason. The department will not be responsible for lapses in communication caused by incorrect or incomplete contact details, such as email ID or mobile numbers. By the declaration in the form, a candidate whose statement is found untrue at any stage of recruitment or thereafter shall be disqualified and liable for penal action. Enquiries: E-mail [email protected] , Tel. No. (0260) 2632303.

faq.question: Q1. How many Gram Rojgar Sahayak (GRS) vacancies are there in DNH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 05 vacancies for the post of Gram Rojgar Sahayak (GRS) in the Department of Rural Development, District Panchayat, Dadra and Nagar Haveli.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DNH Gram Rojgar Sahayak posts?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted to the office of the Programme Officer, VB G RAM G, Silvassa on or before 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Gram Rojgar Sahayak (GRS)?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate from a recognized University or equivalent, well versed with the local language, have good command over Computer applications and MS Office Suite, and have experience of working with community.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DNH Gram Rojgar Sahayak post?
faq.answer: The age must be between 18-30 years; the application form asks for age as on 30/11/2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Gram Rojgar Sahayak in DNH?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs. 18,000/- per month plus Travelling Allowance.

faq.question: Q6. Is any allowance paid on top of the salary?
faq.answer: Yes, Travelling Allowance is paid in addition to the consolidated Rs. 18,000/- per month. However, no TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the DNH Gram Rojgar Sahayak posts?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure-A application form and submit it with attested copies of relevant documents to the Office of Programme Officer, VB G RAM G, Department of Rural Development, (Rural Employment Division), District Panchayat, Dadra and Nagar Haveli, Silvassa - 396230 by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The notice refers to an interview and verification of original Educational, Experience and Identity Proof certificates, with preference to candidates having experience in similar scheme/projects in government domain.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Gram Rojgar Sahayak job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are filled purely on a short term contract basis under VB G RAM G.
